scope: Local browser UI fixture using production EditProfile/PublicProfile components with an isolated generated SDK signer; no real extension
checks: Avatar and cover selection open separate crop dialogs
Keyboard position and zoom controls update the local preview
Use image commits only the local draft
Close dialog returns focus to the file input without submitting the profile
Signed save returns to a profile with both images loaded
Reset clears the preview and Undo restores it
Profile and editor have no horizontal overflow at 320px; crop dialog has no overflow at 360px
Desktop 1440px preview and saved profile render without horizontal overflow
Hosted production profile displays both admitted images at their expected intrinsic dimensions
limitations: Actual MetaMask extension and physical phone acceptance remain R6
Isolated UI fixture lives in ignored apps/web/.local and is excluded from the production entry point
